_README: VERSIONS THIS APP HAS PROVEN, KEYED BY THE FILE'S OWN sha256.
Some payloads write no version into their binary and none into their filename - ftpsrv, nanodns,
ShadowMountPlus and OnionHEN are all like that - so the catalogue would have to show a blank where
a version belongs. But when the file on disk is byte-for-byte the size of an asset in an upstream
release, it IS that release, and that is evidence rather than a guess.
The running app makes that comparison whenever it checks for updates, and writes what it learned
here. The generator then stamps it into the catalogue, so the answer ships inside both ELFs and is
there on a console with no PC and no internet - which is where a version is least guessable and
most wanted. The key is the sha256, so a different build of the same project never inherits it.
Nothing here is hand-written and nothing needs to be. Delete a line and the app will learn it
again the next time it checks.
